title: chore: prune the Serena memory store — archive the handoffs of finished tasks out of list_memories, and merge duplicate gotcha memories
description:
Requested by the human on 2026-10-30 after a governor audit of Serena usage, covering Serena's own logs for 10-27 to 10-30 and .serena/memories.

The audit:
- .serena/memories holds 758 files (~2 MB).
- 349 are task handoffs (task-task-<id>-handoff). 304 of them belong to tasks that are already DONE (203) or ARCHIVED (101); only 45 belong to live tasks.
- 277 are gotcha-* files, which likely overlap heavily. docs/MEMORY.md says to prefer edit_memory over near-duplicates, but nothing enforces it.
- One list_memories call now returns about 36 KB of names (~9k tokens), mostly dead handoffs.

Serena 1.6.2 (WSL, ~/.local/bin/serena) supports `ignored_memory_patterns` in .serena/project.yml. These are regexes, fullmatched against the memory name, and a match is excluded from listing, reading and writing (serena/memories/memory_manager.py). So archived files can be kept on disk but hidden from the tools.

Scope:
1. Move every task-*-handoff memory whose task is DONE or ARCHIVED on the board (read status through moe tools, never by hand-editing .moe) into .serena/memories/_archive/, keeping its name. Then add the pattern `_archive/.*` to .serena/project.yml ignored_memory_patterns. Never move the handoff of a task in PLANNING, AWAITING_APPROVAL, WORKING, REVIEW or BLOCKED.
2. Merge duplicate or near-duplicate gotcha-* (and decision-*) memories. Fold each group into one file named per docs/MEMORY.md, keeping every distinct fact, and archive the merged-away files the same way. Re-point any `mem:<name>` reference you find in the task plans you touch.

Safety: .serena/ is untracked but NOT gitignored, and no commit has ever touched .serena/memories. A landing with attribution.undeclared 'solo' could sweep hundreds of moved files into git. Declare nothing under .serena, and confirm after landing that `git log --oneline -- .serena` is still empty. Whether .serena/memories should be gitignored or added to attribution.exclude is a human call, so ask; don't decide it.
definitionOfDone: Every task-*-handoff memory whose task is DONE or ARCHIVED is in .serena/memories/_archive/, and no live task's handoff moved. The completion summary gives both counts (before and after) and the list of moved names.

.serena/project.yml ignored_memory_patterns contains `_archive/.*`. A fresh Serena session's list_memories (or an equivalent MemoryManager check) shows none of the archived names, and the listing is measurably smaller (state the before and after size).

Duplicate gotcha-*/decision-* groups are merged into single files with no distinct fact dropped, each merge listed as 'kept <name> <- merged <names>'. No path under .serena is committed: `git log --oneline -- .serena` is still empty after the landing.
